course_review/1.card_source: golfify (https://www.golfify.io/courses/prairie-highlands-golf-course), the build's own card; OpenGolfAPI has identical Black/Blue/White yardages on all 18 holes (Red differs on hole 7). Black 7,066 / Blue 6,481 / White 5,770 / Red 5,122, par 72. Club/AllSquare fetch: see course_data/research/web/rv_ph_tg if it arrived.

summary.publish: safe with one caveat: 17/18 holes right on both sets (pars, routing, greens, tees within 3 yds of the card except Black 11 at -12). Blue hole 11 plays from a lidar pad in the trees ~30 yds right of the real tee; its aim is therefore slightly off. Black 17 driver pick lands in a greenside bunker (aggressive, not a data error).

course_notes: qa_page.js re-run 2026-10-30 on Black and Blue: 18 holes, 0 problems on each (only console error is a blocked external cert in the sandbox).
All 18 holes drawn on the page photo with OSM greens, hole lines, all four tee sets and the calm landing spot; every tee except Blue 11 sits on a tee box at the hole start.
